business_problem: Corning collects data from hundreds of sources globally, and new sources emerge almost daily. The company’s legacy data warehousing solution could no longer keep pace, and analytics activities were cumbersome.
solution_summary: Corning built its Databricks implementation around Lakeflow Jobs, More from, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks Assistant. Corning collects data from hundreds of sources globally, and new sources emerge almost daily. The company’s legacy data warehousing solution could no longer keep pace, and analytics activities were cumbersome. Lakeflow Jobs schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations. More from more from is part of the named implementation described in the customer story. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment. Databricks Assistant helps practitioners accelerate code, query, and troubleshooting work inside the Databricks workspace. The solution also connects to Power BI, BigQuery, Airflow, so teams can work from a shared governed environment instead of disconnected tools.
